description: Visual designer for AVEVA E3D PML forms (.pmlfrm) with surgical code edits
cfg.callbackPlacement.init: In the form init method: !this.gad.callback = |…|; on the gadget line if there is no init method
cfg.callbackPlacement: Where to write the callback on gadget double-click
cfg.developer: Author in the header of new forms (-- Developer:). Empty — OS user name
cfg.formNamePrefix: Prefix of new form names (pre-filled and checked in the New Form wizard). Empty — no check
cfg.newFormFolder: Folder for new forms relative to the workspace (e.g. working/gcc). Empty or missing — folder dialog
cfg.language.auto: VS Code display language (Russian for ru, otherwise English)
cfg.language: Designer language: messages, panels and default gadget texts in generated code. Reopen the designer after changing
